Matrix 3.2.0 lets Synapse offload media to an S3-compatible bucket instead of keeping everything on the container's own volume.

## ✨ Added

- **Optional S3-compatible media storage.** Bundles [matrix-org/synapse-s3-storage-provider](https://github.com/matrix-org/synapse-s3-storage-provider) and wires it through a new `S3_MEDIA_ENABLED` opt-in, off by default with the exact same "byte-for-byte unchanged until switched on" contract as Delegated Auth. Turn it on and every new upload is copied to your S3-compatible bucket (SeaweedFS, Garage) in addition to the local volume, which stays a hot cache. Targets a self-hosted backend, not bare AWS - `S3_MEDIA_ENDPOINT` has no default and the container refuses to start with the feature on and no endpoint set, rather than silently talking to real AWS. Live-verified against a real SeaweedFS instance: config renders and merges cleanly alongside Delegated Auth, Synapse boots healthy, client API responsive, no errors.
